ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Access Token Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential token impersonation and theft. Example, when using "DuplicateToken(Ex)" and "ImpersonateLoggedOnUser" with the "LOGON32_LOGON_NEW_CREDENTIALS flag". Note: Unmapped fields: LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, ImpersonationLevel

sequences.query: (event_id = 4624 AND LogonType = 9 AND LogonProcessName = "Advapi" AND AuthenticationPackageName = "Negotiate" AND ImpersonationLevel = "\%\%1833")
